name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding two dumbbells together above your chest with your palms facing each other.
Squeeze the dumbbells firmly against each other and keep that pressure throughout.
Lower the dumbbells to your mid-chest, keeping them touching.
Press back up to the start, still squeezing.
image_prompt_scene: Lying on a flat bench with two dumbbells pressed together above the chest.
